newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks off in early trade, IBM down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks off in early trade, IBM down.

text.p: Wall Street stocks sold off in early trading Thursday with weakness in shares of International Business Machines Corp weighing on the Dow.
Analysts said that regardless of the IBM weakness, investors were set to be cautious today as they prepared for the release of March employment data Friday.
IBM was down 2-1/2 at 131-1/4 after the Wall Street Journal said analysts were slimming 1997 earnings estimates.
The industrials were down 24 points at 6493 while declines led advancing issues by 11 to five. The long bond was off 3/32 to yield 7.08 percent.
